headline: Dualith Noct alpha
title: Dualith Noct | Dark Alpha Boss Location and Drops | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for a new alpha in Palworld one point zero? Dualith Noct waits on Glacial Memento Isle, a small island out past Feybreak. It is a Ground and Dark Pal, so bring Grass or Dragon Pals to hit its weaknesses. The alpha drops Mysterious Mushroom and Large Pal Soul, so it is worth the boat trip. Will you take it on? Comment below!
description: Dualith Noct is a Ground and Dark alpha on Glacial Memento Isle in Palworld 1.0 that drops Mysterious Mushroom and Large Pal Soul.
joke: This alpha lives on an island named after a memento, so bring your own.
